messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — Severity: S2. Elevated quality regression detected for endpoint /v1/generate (hosted). Error-like completions and high customer complaint rate. Metric spikes: rerate > 8% (baseline 0.6%), avg latency stable. Pager sent to oncall. Dashboard: https://internal/redwood/alerts/1843506789 :rotating_light:
mika (oncall): I’m on it. seeing the same spike on our canary traces. Which model was promoted in the last deploy?
jess (ml-eng): That was model: rwd-model-4.2.1-quant. Can confirm evals show an uptick in hallucination-ish tokens on our key prompt set. Likely model change, not infra.
mika (oncall): ok thanks. @sam can you pause the rollout and pin traffic back to previous version?
sam (eng-sre): On it. Stopping rollout now. Running rollback command to route traffic to rwd-model-4.1.9 (stable).
```bash
# API rollback (internal svc)
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/rollouts/rollback \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-model-4.1.9","route":"/v1/generate"}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN"
```
sam (eng-sre): rollback initiated — watching infra logs.
incident-bot: ACTION: rollback started by sam (eng-sre). Canary traffic changed. Notifying subscribers.
kai (support): getting inbound tickets from two enterprise customers complaining about nonsense completions and some downstream parse failures. Severity varies but one customer flagged production impact on their SLA. I drafted a status page update and a customer email.
nate (product): paste the draft here, want to align before we publish. Also need ETA on rollback completion.
kai (support): Draft status page update: "We are investigating an increase in low-quality responses from the hosted text generation endpoint. A rollback to a previous model version is in progress. Customers may see degraded output until the rollback completes. We will provide updates here and via email to impacted customers."
mika (oncall): good start. Add expected ETA: ~10-15m for rollout to converge and caches to clear.
kai (support): updated: "ETA to resolution: 10-15 minutes. Impact: degraded content quality for a subset of requests. Action: rolling back to previously-stable model. No credential or data leak observed."
nate (product): looks fine. Keep it factual, no blame. I'll approve once rollback is confirmed.
jess (ml-eng): one more note — prefix KV caches mean some old responses might persist for a short window depending on customer caching. Consider advising customers to retry or clear cache if possible.
mika (oncall): sam, any completion on the rollback?
sam (eng-sre): Rollback succeeded at the serving layer, routing is back to rwd-model-4.1.9. Waiting for caches to warm and for ongoing requests to drain. Monitoring quality metrics now.
incident-bot: UPDATE — rollback completed. Monitoring for 30m for signal stability.
jess (ml-eng): preliminary metrics: hallucination proxy dropped from 8.4% -> 0.9% in 6 minutes post-rollback on sampled traffic. Still watching.
kai (support): sending approved status page + customer email now. Customer email draft: "Hi — We detected degraded outputs for the text generation API and rolled back to a previous stable model. The rollback has been applied; customers should see restored quality within minutes. If you continue to see issues, please reply and include example inputs/outputs. Apologies for the disruption."
nate (product): send to impacted list and include link to status page. Also add a short note about follow-up postmortem and timeline.
kai (support): sent to impacted customers. Internal recipients only: product+support+ops.
mika (oncall): handing off monitoring to night oncall in 40m. @jess please own the postmortem and model gating action items. @sam own infra rollout policy change. @kai own customer comm follow-ups for any re-opened tickets.
sam (eng-sre): ACK. I’ll add a temporary safeguard to prevent immediate auto-promote of quantized models to 100% without extended canary checks.
jess (ml-eng): ACK. Steps I propose: pin rwd-model-4.1.9 as the default in the model catalog; run the extended prompt eval suite on rwd-model-4.2.1-quant with new hallucination alerts; add a pre-rollout quality gate in CI.
mika (oncall): good. Also schedule an exec summary for tomorrow morning with topline impact + customer list.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — S2 regression mitigated after model rollback. Monitoring window started. Please file postmortem in incidents/postmortems within 48h.
kai (support): one customer replied with examples — forwarding to @jess and @sam for deeper triage.
jess (ml-eng): got them. running local reproductions now. initial look suggests tokenization differences under quantized path caused truncation-related hallucinations for certain prompt templates.
sam (eng-sre): taking an action item: add canary size and duration bump for model promotions, and alert when output-quality delta > 1% relative to baseline.
mika (oncall): thanks team. Closing active pager. Leaving this thread for the postmortem write-up. Tagging participants for visibility :eyes: :thumbsup:
